status.description: free text: the authored lifecycle word (`todo`, `done`); the archetype declares no vocabulary for it.

track.description: The parallel-execution track label (FR-005). A property of a Task; a consumer needing a tree node synthesises one.

relationships.description: Absent when the author declared none; the frontmatter schemas do not require the key, and the model must not require what the schema does not (FR-011-AC-15).

body.description: free text: the whole authored body; the archetype declares no `body_extraction`.

description:
Task record (archetype `Task`). The authored unit of work: its track, its
dependencies and the tests it verifies. Not a record of the task being done.
